text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We overcome our previously<n>undefeated rival,
winning round four<n>of the Unity Cup. Rice Shower is
eager<n>to keep up the momentum and seize<n>victory
again in our next bout.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Little Cocon and Bitter Glasse,<n>however, won't
make it easy. After<n>seeing our progress, they're
determined not to let us beat them.
